5.name: Moira Mactaggert
5.text: One <hero /> with <mutant /> may count one tag twice.

9.name: Fearless
9.text: Blanked if there is more than one <hero /> in your hand.

10.name: Secret ID
10.text: Blanked unless with a <hero /> AND a <location /> with <urban />.

11.name: Worthy
11.text: Blanked unless with a <villain /> with Power greater than 12.

12.name: Berserk
12.text: Choose a <hero /> or <ally />. <score-negative>-3</score-negative> for each OTHER <hero /> or <ally /> and each <urban />.

13.name: Spear of Bashenga
13.text: <score>+7</score> for each other <equipment /> and each other <wakanda />.

15.name: X-Jet
15.text: Add <flight /> to each <hero /> and <ally /> with no <flight />. Add <range /> to one <hero /> or <ally />.

17.name: Mjolnir
17.text: Blanked unless with <name>Worthy</name>, or unless with a <hero /> or <ally /> with <worthy />.

18.name: Cerebro
18.text: If you take <name>Cerebro</name> from the discard area, you may swap a card in your hand with a card in the discard area if either has <mutant />.

27.name: Rogue
27.text: <name>Rogue</name> may copy the base power and one tag of another <hero /> in your hand.

28.name: Shuri
28.text: <name>Shuri</name> and one other <hero /> or <ally /> may each add one of <strength />, <range />, or <agility />.

30.name: Thor Odinson
30.text: Transform with <name>Mjolnir</name> or two or more <ally>Allies</ally>.

32.name: Jean Grey
32.text: Transform with two or more other <mutant />.

33.name: Vision
33.text: <name>Vision</name> has your choice of two different tags, either <strength />, <flight />, <tech />, or <range />.

43.name: High Speed Chase
43.text: <score>+3</score> for each <agility />, for each <flight />, and for each <range />.

52.name: Hidden Lair
52.text: Blank a <villain /> unless with two or more <intel />.

54.name: Xavier Mansion
54.text: Up to three <hero>Heroes</hero> with <mutant /> may each count one tag twice.

60.name: Avoid Crossfire
60.text: <score>+5|7|9</score> for each <range /> if with one|two|three or more cards with <range />.

61.name: Hack In
61.text: <score>+6</score> for each <tech />. Each <tech /> also counts as <intel />.

62.name: Kang
62.text: <score>+5</score> for each different tag in your hand.

66.name: Mystique
66.text: <score-negative>-20</score-negative> unless with two or more <intel /> OR any three cards sharing the same tag.

70.name: Hela
70.text: <score-negative>-20</score-negative> unless with two or more other <asgard />.

73.name: Loki
73.text: At the end of the game, draw a card from the Remix deck and subtract its base power.

74.name: Magneto
74.text: Blank all <equipment /> and ignore all <tech />. (cards with <tech /> keep their other details)

76.name: Selene
76.text: Blank any <hero /> or <ally /> in your hand. Subtract its base power from your total score.

80.name: Squirrel Girl
80.text: Ignore the text box for all <villain>Villains</villain>. All negative <villain>Villain</villain> base powers become positive.

81.name: Mantis
81.text: <score>+</score> one number that appears before the words 'for each' or 'with' on one other <hero /> or <ally />.

88.name: In-Betweener
88.text: <score-negative>-15</score-negative> unless you have at least three cards with base power values higher than <name>In-Betweener</name> and three cards with base power below.

89.name: Uatu, The Watcher
89.text: To keep or recruit <name>Uatu, The Watcher</name>, you must correctly name three non-<cosmic /> cards, and which other player holds each card. If you are correct, you may keep this card. Otherwise place it in the discard area and end your turn.

90.name: Unexpected Strength
90.text: Blanked unless your hand has more <ally>Allies</ally> than <hero>Heroes</hero>.

94.name: Exiled
94.text: Blanked unless with three or more <space />.

95.name: Infinity Gauntlet
95.text: <score>+13</score> for each <infinity_stone />. If you have this card and six cards with <infinity_stone />, reveal it immediately and you win!

97.name: The Milano
97.text: <score>+3</score> for each <guardian />, for each <tech />, and for each <agility />.

101.name: Power Stone
101.text: Double all tags on one other card in your hand.

102.name: Reality Stone
102.text: Choose a tag on a card in your hand and count it as <magic />. (<magic /> may count as any other tag.)

103.name: Space Stone
103.text: Shuffle all non-<cosmic /> cards from the discard area and place them onto the bottom of their deck, then replace them with an equal number of cards from the top of the Remix deck. Then take another turn.

104.name: Mind Stone
104.text: ENDGAME: You may choose one unblanked <hero /> or <ally /> in an opponent's hand and count it as an additional card in your hand. If it can transform, use the state the opponent is using.

105.name: Soul Stone
105.text: Discard a <hero /> or <ally /> from your hand and remove it from the game. Draw six cards from the Remix deck, keep one non-<cosmic /> card, and remove the other five from the game.

106.name: Time Stone
106.text: Name a tag. Reveal cards from either deck until you reveal a card with that tag or twelve cards. Place the last card in the discard area. Put the others on the bottom of the deck. Then take another turn.

108.name: Silver Surfer
108.text: If <name>Silver Surfer</name> is placed in the discard area with six or fewer other cards in the discard area, place the <name>Galactus</name> card in play.

109.name: Doctor Strange
109.text: (<magic /> may count as any other tag.)

122.name: Invisible Woman
122.text: <score>+3</score> for each card with 0 base power.

123.name: Moondragon
123.text: <score>+3</score> for each other <intel /> and for each other <guardian /> in your hand and the hands of the players to your left and right.

128.name: Sakaar - Planet Hulk
128.text: <score>+5</score> for each <hero /> in the discard area.

131.name: Research Lab
131.text: Blanked unless with <tech />. (<magic /> may count as any other tag.)

134.name: Citadel at the End of Time
134.text: ENDGAME: Reveal <name>Citadel at the End of Time</name> from your hand at the end of the game to take one extra turn.

135.name: Anti-Alien Riots
135.text: Blanked unless with both <space /> and another <urban />.

136.name: Prison Break
136.text: Blanked unless with all of <intel />, <agility />, and <flight />.

137.name: Ego
137.text: Draw six cards from either deck. Add one to the discard area and remove the rest from the game. Then take another turn.

138.name: Battleworld
138.text: <score>+10</score> for each <hero />-<villain /> pair, <score-negative>-20</score-negative> for each unmatched <hero /> or <villain />.

139.name: Interdimensional Rift
139.text: To keep or recruit <name>Interdimensional Rift</name>, reveal cards from your hand with at least one <time /> and one <space />.

146.name: Travel Through Time
146.text: Choose 0-4 non-<cosmic /> cards from the discard area and remove them from the game, then replace them with an equal number of cards from the bottom of the Remix deck. Then take another turn.

147.name: Galactus
147.text: If <name>Galactus</name> is in play, any player with fewer than seven different tags on <hero>Heroes</hero>, <ally>Allies</ally>, and <equipment /> loses 30 points, and the player or players with the most different tags on these cards gains 15 points. <name>Galactus</name> counts as an extra card in all players' hands.

148.name: Magus
148.transformText: Transform with another <time />. Cards with <infinity_stone /> all count as 0 for you, instead of their printed value.

149.name: Venom
149.text: Transform with one or more <ally />. (As <name>Venom, Space Knight</name>, copy a tag on one <ally />.)

150.name: Nebula
150.text: Transform with <guardian /> or two or more <intel />.

152.name: Thanos
152.text: Instead of taking a normal turn, you may reveal this card and steal an <infinity_stone /> from another player. That player may immediately take an extra turn. After they do so, activate the <infinity_stone /> you stole if it has an ability. <score>+10</score> for each <infinity_stone />.

153.name: Invading Armada
153.text: <score>+5</score> for each other <space />, for each <flight />, and for each <range />.

155.name: Supreme Intelligence
155.text: <score>+7</score> for each <intel /> and for each other <kree />.

160.name: Annihilus
160.text: Choose another card in your hand that contains a negative number anywhere on the card. Add the absolute value of that number (the same number without the negative sign) to <name>Annihilus</name>.

161.name: Carnage
161.text: Add one number that appears before the words 'for each' on one other <villain />.

162.name: Immortus
162.text: <score-negative>-20</score-negative> unless with at least one other <time />.

163.name: The Matriarch
163.text: <score-negative>-20</score-negative> if your hand contains more than six different tags.

164.name: The High Evolutionary
164.text: <score-negative>-20</score-negative> unless with six or more different types of card in the discard area.

165.name: Toxin
165.text: Double one tag on a <hero />, <ally />, or <villain />.

166.name: Champion
166.text: To keep or recruit <name>Champion</name>, reveal cards from your hand with at least three <strength /> tags.

167.name: Collector
167.text: <score>+3</score> with three cards of the same type, <score>+5</score> with four cards of the same type, <score>+10</score> with five, <score>+20</score> with six, or <score>+35</score> with seven.

168.name: Grandmaster
168.text: When <name>Grandmaster</name> is drawn, reveal it, and all players may simultaneously reveal any two non-<villain /> cards from their hands. The player with the highest total strength of the two cards may keep this card. If there is a tie, keep revealing cards until the tie is broken. Then take another turn.
